## Study Checklist

### Phase 1: Research & Analysis
- [ ] Review original papers and key references
- [ ] Understand historical motivation and context
- [ ] Analyze architectural innovations
- [ ] Document key mathematical insights

### Phase 2: Documentation
- [ ] Create comprehensive README
- [ ] Develop architectural diagrams
- [ ] Write educational explanations
- [ ] Document connections to other models

### Phase 3: Simplified Implementation (Optional)
- [ ] Create pseudocode or simplified implementation
- [ ] Focus on key algorithmic insights
- [ ] Educational code with extensive comments
- [ ] Visualization of key concepts

## Quality Gates

### Educational Completeness
- [ ] Historical context clearly explained
- [ ] Mathematical foundations documented
- [ ] Architectural innovations highlighted
- [ ] Connection to learning progression clear

### Documentation Quality
- [ ] Comprehensive README following template
- [ ] Clear and accessible explanations
- [ ] Visual aids and diagrams where helpful
- [ ] Proper citations and references
